Title: Protean reprints - what's in, what's out (speculation)

Messages.Author: Eric Simon
Messages.Body:
Okay, so we've seen up through part of "C", and there's only one
reprint on the list so far. Let's take a look at what's in and out so
far and extrapolate for the rest of the list:

1. Adaptability - OUT (Printed in Sabbat War)
2. Beast Meld - OUT (New in Bloodlines)
3. Body Flare - OUT (Printed in Sabbat War)
4. Body of Sun - OUT (Erm, because it's stupid?)
5. Bone Spur - IN (Not printed since Sabbat)
6. Carrion Coffin - OUT (Probably phased out in favor of Homunculus)

Based on these, I'm making my guesses on what's in and out for the
rest of it:
[Speculation Mode]

7. Claws of the Dead - IN (Not printed since V:TES)
8. Dissolution - OUT (Printed in Sabbat War)
9. Earth Control - IN (Not printed since V:TES)
10. Earth Meld - IN (Probably recosted to match Majesty and Catatonic
Fear)
11. Flesh of Marble - IN (Not printed since V:TES)
12. Form of Mist - IN (Something's being done to it. Don't know
what.)
13. Form of the Ghost - OUT (Was abandoned in favor of Gleam during
Sabbat. Probably gone for good.)
14. Gleam of the Red Eyes - IN (See above)
15. Homunculus - IN (See notes under Carrion Coffin)
16. Horrific Countenance - IN??? (Currently the only completely
unblockable action mod. Will it stay in? If so, it probably needs to
be rewritten, possibly split into inferior and superior versions.)
17. Movement of the Slow Body - OUT (Abandoned after Jyhad, never to
resurface again)
18. Mythic Form - OUT (New in Final Nights)
19. Quick Meld - OUT (Printed in Sabbat War)
20. Rapid Change - OUT (Printed in Sabbat War)
21. Shadow of the Beast - OUT (Printed in Sabbat War)
22. Shadow of the Wolf - OUT??? (Not printed since Ancient Hearts -
possibly abandoned)
23. Uncontrollable Rage - OUT??? (Same as above - possibly abandoned)
24. Wolf Claws - OUT (Printed in Sabbat War, and if you have Claws of
the Dead and Bone Spur, you don't need Wolf Claws)

That's my guess, posted so all the world can see how right or wrong I
am. Discussion?

Messages.Author: James O'Rance
Messages.Body:

> > 18. Mythic Form - OUT (New in Final Nights)
>
> While I understand your reason, this card is so super rare, I think it
> needs reprinting...

I think that Mythic Form was never meant to be an often-used card, or
it -wouldn't- be so rare. It's a weird and unusual Protean card, not
intended to be a staple.

As for Bone Spur, Claws of the Dead, and Wolf Claws, I think we'll see
all three reprinted. They each do different things. Claws of the Dead
can give you a meaneuver; Wolf Claws can give you a press; printing
one but not the other would hurt protean combat decks (my Gangrel
Antitribu Amaranth deck uses both).

Messages.Author: Eric Simon
Messages.Body:
vol...@yahoo.com (Eric Simon) wrote in message news:<6f81fa2c.03041...@posting.google.com>...



So it turns out I'm mostly right, with some interesting misses.
Here's my comments -

Form of the Ghost is IN
In retrospect, this is probably the right choice. Having the maneuver
at inferior is generally more useful than the press for protean
combat.

We have seen eight of the nine booster reprints, so my speculation on
the final reprint is that it won't be another protean card. There's
no need for both Gleam and Ghost, so Gleam is probably out. And I
doubt at this point that it will be Homunculus or Uncontrollable Rage,
as there is no need to make either of those even a C2. As stated
before, it seems more likely that the "goofy" protean cards will be in
the Gangrel precon. So what do I think that last reprint will be?
Renegade Garou, hopefully recosted down to 4 pool (or even less).
This card NEEDS recosting, and WW has shown in the past that they
won't put modified reprints as starter-only. Backways and Zoo Hunting
Ground are both certain to appear in the starter. I doubt they'll
bother with Gangrel Revel, Gypsies, Ritual Challenge or Shackles of
Enkidu, but if they do they'll be in the starter. This leaves Dog
Pack and Renegade Garou, and we're already past "D" in the checklist,
so my guess is Renegade Garou. However, I do hope Dog Pack is in the
starter. Please?
